items.name: Fresh Peach Shake
items.description: A fresh and creamy peach shake made with real peaches, vanilla ice cream, and a hint of cinnamon. Perfect for cooling down on a hot summer day.

items.name: Double Bacon Cheeseburger Combo
items.description: A hearty burger with two beef patties, two slices of melted cheese, and several strips of bacon.  Served with your choice of regular or waffle fries and a fountain drink.

items.name: Pepperoni Pizza Pocket Combo
items.description: Delicious hot pizza pockets filled with pepperoni, mozzarella cheese, and a rich tomato sauce.  Served with your choice of regular or waffle fries and a fountain drink.
